planets.text: Saturn is in Meena all month, your 8th house from the lagna. It is moving backwards (retrograde) as the month begins.
planets.theme: The 8th house is about change and things shared with others.

planets.text: Jupiter is in Simha all month, your 1st house from the lagna.
planets.theme: The 1st house is about yourself and how you begin things.

planets.text: Rahu begins the month in Kumbha, your 7th house from the lagna.
planets.theme: The 6th house is about daily work and challenges to get through.

moves.text: On 5 December 2026 it moves into Makara, your 6th house.

planets.text: Ketu begins the month in Simha, your 1st house from the lagna.
planets.theme: The 12th house is about rest, spending and faraway places.

moves.text: On 5 December 2026 it moves into Kataka, your 12th house.
